content.text:
TASK:
Record a COMPLETE funds-transfer capability against MERIDIAN CORE. (1) Sign on: Operator ID, Password, leave Branch, click Sign On. (2) Open Member Inquiry, search by Member Number for the memberId parameter, click Select. (3) Click 'Funds Transfer'. (4) On the form: for From Share call choose with option = the fromShare parameter value verbatim (it is the option's underlying value attribute, NOT the visible label); for To Share choose the toShare parameter value verbatim; type amount into Amount; type memo into Memo; click Continue. (5) On CONFIRM FUNDS TRANSFER the money has NOT moved — click 'Post Transfer' with irreversible=true (a human pre-authorised this recording). (6) On the receipt screen, use read to capture the confirmation/reference number into an output named 'confirmationNumber' — target the value cell that sits next to the 'Confirmation:' label. (7) Then declare_done with capability_id 'member.transferFunds'.

PARAMETERS:
- memberId (internal): Caller-supplied parameter 'memberId'. — value: "101555"
- fromShare (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'fromShare'. — value: "101555-S0001"
- toShare (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'toShare'. — value: "101555-CERT"
- amount (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'amount'. — value: "5.00"
- memo (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'memo'. — value: "Capability recording"
- operatorId (internal): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_ID) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: "teller1"
- operatorPassword (secret): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_PASSWORD) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)

The application is served at https://web-sample.interface-hiring.com. The browser is currently blank — begin by navigating to the application.

input.intent: Open the MERIDIAN CORE application to begin sign on.

input.title: Member Funds Transfer
input.description: Signs on to MERIDIAN CORE, opens Member Inquiry, searches by Member Number for memberId and selects the member, then posts a Funds Transfer. Inputs: memberId, fromShare and toShare (share value attributes), amount, memo, plus operator credentials from the environment. Executes the transfer (irreversible Post Transfer) and returns the receipt's confirmationNumber. Outcome: transfer posted successfully.
